layers.name: Solder balls
layers.info: Ball grid array joining the package to the card's PCB. Only the outer rows are drawn; ball count and pitch are approximate.

parts.name: BGA solder balls
parts.info: Solder balls that join the package to the board. Pitch and count are approximate (not published).

layers.name: Bottom build-up
layers.info: Fine copper wiring layers that spread the die's connections out to the balls. Layer count approximate.

layers.name: Core
layers.info: Stiff glass-fibre core with copper-plated through-holes; keeps the package flat.

layers.name: Top build-up
layers.info: Densest wiring, directly under the die: memory, PCIe and display lanes fan out from here.

layers.name: Solder mask
layers.info: Lacquer on top of the substrate; the die bumps land through openings in it.

parts.name: C4 bumps
parts.info: Microscopic solder bumps under the die (flip-chip). Pitch and count approximate.

parts.name: Decoupling capacitors
parts.info: Small ceramic capacitors that keep the die's supply steady during load spikes.

parts.name: Stiffener frame
parts.info: Metal ring around the die that stops the bare (lid-less) package from warping. Shape approximate; one side drawn.

layers.name: Die
layers.info: The GB203 die, mounted face-down with no heatspreader; the cooler touches it directly.

parts.name: GB203 die
parts.info: Bare silicon die. 19.6 × 19.3 mm is an approximation matching the published 378 mm² area. Dive in for its layers and floorplan.
